issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() as returning int, but the template's comment and the solution implementation indicate a double return type. This conflicting specification (int in the UML vs. double in template comment and solution) can confuse students about which return type to implement and may cause them to choose the wrong signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent across all artifacts. Recommended: update the UML in problem_statement.md to declare getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(): double (and mention in the text that a double is expected for precise calculation), so it matches the template comment and the solution. Alternatively, if an integer result is intended, change the template comment and solution implementation to return int and adjust any guidance text accordingly.
